verdict.rationale: The evidence covers pre-production testing only. Voice Test Suites run simulated phone conversations, and Evals validate mock conversations against expected behaviors. Nothing documents AI reviewing actual production calls to score quality, flag failures, or analyze resolution. That makes these testing features adjacent rather than direct support for automated call review.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
